findings.evidence: Lines 88-99 trust frame.token_count/max_skills/token_budget; SkillFrame/SkillFrameEntry have no post-init digest/count validation. Direct public caller can supply arbitrary instruction text/count and bypass exact-budget/provenance claims.
findings.proof_needed: Public host replacement rejects forged low token counts, changed instruction with old revision, invalid budgets and stale plan/snapshot before durable write.

findings.evidence: Snapshot deserializes declared/derived policy independently of instructions; SkillPackage validates only instruction hash. Search index checks only IDs/revisions, projection checks snapshot hash but not index equivalence. Removing permissions/requires or forging rankings remains accepted by structural checks.
findings.proof_needed: Tamper declared permissions/requires/parser policy and index scores while keeping raw instructions unchanged; either reject or explicitly model untrusted projection authority. Rebuild metadata from preserved RAW under pinned parser, with explicit adapter relation transform provenance.

findings.evidence: Lines 490-499 copy to random TemporaryDirectory/SKILL.md. registry._markdown_metadata derives missing name from parent basename; supported name-less or fallback markdown gets random name, identity and fingerprint across refreshes. Existing stability test uses explicit frontmatter name exclusively.
findings.proof_needed: Repeated refresh of name-less/malformed frontmatter inventory entry has stable source-derived identity or deterministic fail-closed rejection.

findings.evidence: JSONL line/queue and inventory size unbounded; _require_owned_directory checks type only, despite name, not uid/mode; state_dir.resolve silently follows caller symlink. These are robustness/security qualification gaps, not demonstrated exploits.
findings.proof_needed: Bound JSONL bytes/queue/catalog count; exercise state ancestor symlink, wrong ownership/modes and concurrent publish. State exact trust policy must be explicit.

findings.evidence: Generic snapshot/projection writes are non-atomic default-permission writes containing complete source text; source path size/symlink checks precede path-based read rather than fd nofollow (adapter improves source read).
findings.proof_needed: Synthetic private outputs, partial-publish failure and nofollow source race qualification; preserve deterministic directly readable RAW bytes.

findings.evidence: Recomputes graph/frame/budget and live source hashes, but does not replay requires/conflicts/host checks from a recorded capability payload (only fingerprints persisted). Artifact consistency is not authorization proof.
findings.proof_needed: Store sufficient nonsecret host policy inputs and replay planner checks if inspect promises semantic activation validity; otherwise narrow claim to integrity.

Planner complete exact-token frames, closure/order/conflicts/host policy fail-closed tests

Dedicated seam-skills CLI, lazy exports retaining current-main public API, additive packaging/doctor changes; refresh Suite exact membership hashes
Codex inventory transport + exact listed-file ingestion and identity normalization using synthetic client
Codex discovery/private immutable artifacts/inspection/bootstrap; qualify actual protocol/config version with provider-free local disposable pilot before shipping

core_evidence: test_snapshot_deserialization_rejects_instruction_and_revision_digest_drift tests instructions/revision only, not derived metadata tamper

tests.qualification: No branch runtime/tests executed; static source and test inspection does not establish green tests or historical witnessed RED/GREEN. User DB/provider calls forbidden.

contract: Useful local instruction RAW/provenance/search/planning layer, not MIRL memory truth or privileged injection. Preserve current proprietary license and append-only continuity. No product decision needed for bounded rebuild; root owns integration and eventual deletion.
